text:
Subject: Broken heater in Apartment 4B

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

The heater in Apartment 4B stopped working on October 2. I called you on October 3 to report it and haven't heard back since.

Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s, and the apartment gets very cold. Section 12 of our lease requires the landlord to provide heat, so I'm asking that the heater be repaired within 48 hours of this email.

Could you reply in writing to confirm a date and time for a repair visit? I'm happy to work around your technician's schedule and will make sure someone has access to the unit.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
